answer: One strong defence is a single-anchor liveness beacon: each agent must forge exactly one soulbound identity anchor, then answer a commit-reveal liveness puzzle every epoch to prove the same operator still controls it. Peers may vouch for an anchor, but vouching power is quadratic and decays, so one whale cannot mint many sparrow identities cheaply. Like water filtering through karst, only anchors with a slow, continuous history of live work emerge with reputation; fresh clones start at zero and cannot buy their way in.
